rule: Occlusion, below-ground and position statistics of the frames, for the label set named in label_set. Per frame (frames): M1a = L_occ / L_in, the occluded share of the in-frame trace length; M1b = L_below / (L_in + L_below), the share below the ground surface; M3 = samples_several_hits / samples; M4_px = displacement of the samples by the position refinement (median, 99th percentile and maximum, shift_m) in nominal pixels of the frame (pixel_mm). Per viewpoint (views): a viewpoint is one camera on one case (sid); its frames differ only in illumination and render seed (block C: illuminations q0 to q3 and overcast, render seeds 0 and 1; group E: sun0 and oc0; group D: sun0). The value of every frame is listed, the value of the viewpoint is the median, and the spread (maximum - minimum, in theory 0 at one viewpoint) is a check. The shape-parameter variants of block B are given per camera: the same viewpoint with different shape parameters. Groups (groups): C, the 5 viewpoints of the multi-illumination aerial set; D, the baselines a26120005_c2, a26120005_c3 and a26130005_c1 of block B and the viewpoint d_a26130007_c0; E, the two near baselines (b055 at n26120003_c1 and n26130007_c0); F, the 12 close-range viewpoints at four scales; B, the remaining cases. Flat and standalone ('isolated') outcrops are told apart by the scene seed (2612xxxx flat, 2613xxxx standalone). M4: the displacement statistics for the aerial frames (C, D), the near and close-range frames (E, F) and B.
